name: Yongnan Zhuang
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible
sweep_summary: Yongnan Zhuang (yong1275) is not in the catalog. All three title-keyword items Glottolog 5.1 attaches to it (Bögel et al. 2009 LFG09 prosody architecture; O'Connor 2005 LFG05 Serbian clitics, abstract only; Ravignani et al. 2019 animal chorusing) were opened and are computerised-assignment noise: none mentions Zhuang or any Tai-Kadai language and none states where word stress falls in any language. No first-hand statement about word stress in Yongnan Zhuang was read in this sweep. The genuinely relevant descriptions remain unreachable, as in the earlier pass logged in : Zhang Junru et al. 1999 Zhuangyu fangyan yanjiu (print only; has the Yongning/Fusui/Long'an/Shangsi/Qinzhou point phonologies), Luo 2008 'Zhuang' in The Tai-Kadai Languages (Routledge, paywalled), Pan Yanhong 2010 HKU thesis on Qinzhou Zhuang (hub.hku.hk 403 to automated fetch and web lookups, no Wayback capture, CORE 429), Wei Mingying 2017 on the Yongning tone split (CNKI/NCPSSD login). Files and md5s are logged in (addendum stamped 2026-09-17T15:29:24Z).

sources.citation: Jackson, Emily H. S., Eric M. Jackson & Lau Shuh Huey. 2012. A Sociolinguistic Survey of the Dejing Zhuang Dialect Area. SIL Electronic Survey Report 2012-036. 168 pp.
sources.note: Mentions Yongnan only to say the Long'an/Nong'an variety of Jingxi 'likely belongs to Yongnan Zhuang [zyn]' and that zyn is spoken around Butu; 'stress' occurs once, non-linguistically. Silent.

sources.citation: Pittayaporn, Pittayawat. 2009. The Phonology of Proto-Tai. PhD dissertation, Cornell University. xix+417 pp.
sources.note: Comparative reconstruction; Yongnan (邕南), Long'an, Fusui, Qinzhou data taken from Zhang et al. 1999, Shangsi from the author's 2009 fieldwork (dialect table p. 322). p. 3: 'All Tai languages are basically monosyllabic and tonal.' 'Stress' appears only in the Proto-Tai prosodic-word/sesquisyllable discussion (p. 42: minor syllable unstressed) and typological asides (Chamic, Latin, Pintupi). No statement about word stress in Yongnan or any modern Zhuang variety.
